privacy.retained: Actions, pass/fail, timing and host/capture metadata only.

snapshot.method: Sequential calls; monotonic host round-trip milliseconds; no target input; images only in memory.
snapshot.cold_capture_note: Cold only if no other capture subscriber/request kept the source running.

frame_difference.processing: JPEG base64/decode, grayscale, bilinear resize, absolute delta; outside API timing.

api.method: Fresh baseline before input; sequential fresh-frame polling until threshold or timeout; 480x270 bilinear grayscale; luma delta>12.
limits: Pixel change does not establish causality, semantic completion, or true HDMI capture time.
macOS upstream video buffering is included but unmeasured; polling adds quantization.
Detection includes client JPEG decode and pixel comparison, excludes baseline acquisition and controller LLM latency.
Idle controls calibrate both thresholds on this scene, not all possible UI activity.
Input acknowledgement means input-call completion and host serial pacing; it proves neither UART completion nor target acknowledgement.

One target, host and capture card; one ready-signal session.
Host call and pixel-change timings exclude controller inference, network and scheduling.
Physical measurements used the connected Windows target; Linux-target semantic/completion validation was not performed.
No product implementation changed; timing opportunity estimates are not patched performance results.
